## Details

<a id="tool_line"></a>
### [`tool_line`](../../../../src/tools/line_tool.asm#L6) `$1025`

*routine*

Line command (code 2). Shows the label LINE (script $2eb1) and the picture. The first press sets the start point, the second press sets the end point. Then the line moves with the cursor until the third press. Then the line is drawn with the brush in current_colour.

- **Entry of:** [`command_table`](../../tables.md#command_table)
- **Calls:** [`start_tool`](tool_start.md#start_tool), [`wait_first_point`](line_tool.md#wait_first_point), [`line_rubber_band`](line_tool.md#line_rubber_band), [`line_move`](line_tool.md#line_move), [`draw_line_brush`](../graphics/bresenham_line.md#draw_line_brush)
- **Reads:** [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour), [`background_colour`](../../memory-map.md#background_colour), [`saved_colour`](../../memory-map.md#saved_colour)
- **Writes:** [`saved_colour`](../../memory-map.md#saved_colour), [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour)

<a id="line_rubber_band"></a>
### [`line_rubber_band`](../../../../src/tools/line_tool.asm#L23) `$1047`

*routine*

Moves the end of the line (line_x1, line_y1) with the cursor and shows the line with XOR ($2793) until a new button press. Keeps the last cursor position in shape_x0/shape_y0. A long press off the pad erases the line, restores current_colour from saved_colour and goes to tool_exit.

- **Called from:** [`cmd_lines`](lines.md#cmd_lines), [`tool_line`](line_tool.md#tool_line)

<a id="line_move"></a>
### [`line_move`](../../../../src/tools/line_tool.asm#L62) `$1093`

*routine*

Moves the line with the cursor until a new button press. The cursor sets the end (line_x1, line_y1). The start keeps its distance delta_x/delta_y from the end, in the limits 0-max_x and 0-max_y. Shows the line with XOR and erases it at the end. A long press off the pad goes to tool_exit.
delta_x = line_x0 - line_x1 (16 bits).

- **Called from:** [`tool_line`](line_tool.md#tool_line)
- **Calls:** [`update_cursor`](../input/cursor.md#update_cursor), [`long_press_off_pad`](../input/buttons.md#long_press_off_pad), [`draw_line_xor`](../graphics/bresenham_line.md#draw_line_xor), [`button_pressed`](../input/buttons.md#button_pressed)

<a id="wait_first_point"></a>
### [`wait_first_point`](../../../../src/tools/line_tool.asm#L186) `$1168`

*routine*

Waits for a button press while the pen is on the pad. Then sets both ends of the line (line_x0/y0, line_x1/y1) to the cursor and draws this point with XOR ($2793). A long press off the pad restores current_colour from saved_colour and goes to tool_exit. Line, Lines, Rays, Circle, Disc, Box, Frame and Copy use it.

- **Called from:** [`cmd_lines`](lines.md#cmd_lines), [`cmd_rays`](rays.md#cmd_rays), [`cmd_disc`](circle.md#cmd_disc), [`cmd_circle`](circle.md#cmd_circle), [`tool_line`](line_tool.md#tool_line), [`tool_box`](box_frame_tool.md#tool_box), [`tool_frame`](box_frame_tool.md#tool_frame), [`copy_tool`](copy.md#copy_tool)
